property_summary: After a successful withdrawAll by the owner, the contract's balance becomes zero in the reference version, but the buggy version also transfers funds to address(0) leaving the contract balance zero, so this property does not distinguish them; instead, the reference should transfer all funds to the caller-specified recipient, while the bug sends them to address(0), meaning a helper contract deployed as recipient will see its balance increase in the reference but not in the bug.
change_summary: Replace the recipient with address(0), so funds are sent to the zero address instead of the provided _recipient.
